name: Padded Goods Wrap
description:
Soft wool panels and ties protect a small parcel from knocks during transport. They do not automatically suppress noise or evade inspection.

Legality and provenance depend on the campaign. The GM confirms restrictions and any checks; this item grants no automatic access, immunity or bonus.
